title: recipes.json — declared review pipelines
description: The declared review pipelines a run resolves by name from .verdict/recipes.json at the PR base: lenses, synthesizer hint, and budget, compiled into the four-stage plan data.recipe and launcher.json record, whose shape is published here as $defs/plan. The file is a review control, read from the base snapshot and hash-gated like the typed configuration, so a head edit never steers the pipeline it is judged by. Positions are declarations, not selections: run launches one process and never chooses a model. Every key is spelled exactly as published; the loader refuses any other case, an unknown key, and a duplicate key with bad-recipe.

recipes.description: One named entry per pipeline. run resolves --recipe <slug> here first; a name is a map key and never a path. The key is a lowercase slug of 1 to 64 characters, enforced by the propertyNames pattern published here.

recipe.description: One named pipeline: the version it declares, an optional description and budget, an optional lens set, and the required synthesizer hint.

version.description: Entry semver of 1 to 64 characters, recorded verbatim in data.recipe and launcher.json. A field change moves the recorded sha256, so the same document always records the same plan.

description.description: Operator prose for humans, at most 280 characters. It is never rendered into the directive: only validated ids, enums, numbers, and pattern-checked hints reach the prompt.

budget_usd.description: Declared USD budget for the whole pipeline, above zero. It is recorded and rendered, and a value above the bundle's spend.personal_limit_usd warns; run enforces nothing and never refuses on it.

lenses.description: The lens set the pipeline declares, in declaration order, at most 64 rows: the same lens cap a pack manifest ships. Omit it to inherit the bundle's loaded lenses from lenses.txt in file order. A declared lens the bundle does not load warns and never refuses: lens offers are per plan group, and fetch is the authority on them.

synthesize.description: The synthesizer stage's model hint. The empty object is the "no hint" spelling, and it is the built-in default's whole entry besides its version.

lens.description: One declared lens: the id it selects, its model hint, and the per-lens dispatch caps the reviewer-subagent contract states.

id.description: Lens id: a lowercase slug of 1 to 64 characters, the pattern published here. A missing lens warns; a repeated id in one entry refuses bad-recipe.

model.description: Model hint for this lens: 1 to 64 characters of letters, digits, and ._:/@+~- (the pattern published here), so a hint can never reshape the directive. Verdict never selects a model.

max_files.description: How many changed files this lens may read, 1 to 24.

max_findings.description: How many findings this lens may return, 1 to 20.

synthesize.description: The synthesizer stage's declaration. Only a model hint is declared; dedupe and rank take none.

model.description: Synthesizer model hint, same grammar and cap as a lens hint.

plan.description: The resolved pipeline: the shape of data.recipe in the run --json envelope and of the recipe key in launcher.json, which are byte-identical objects. run compiles one declared entry into exactly four stages and records what it declared; it never dispatches them.

name.description: The recipe name the run resolved: the --recipe slug, or default when the flag was omitted.

version.description: The selected entry's declared version, verbatim.

source.description: Where the entry came from: the base snapshot's .verdict/recipes.json (repo), or the embedded set (builtin). A repository entry wins by name.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the selected entry's canonical JSON, so any field change moves it and the same document always records the same digest.

budget_usd.description: The declared budget, present only when the entry declared one above zero. Recorded and rendered; run warns above the bundle's personal limit and enforces nothing.

stages.description: The pipeline stages, exactly four and in this order: lenses, synthesize, dedupe, and rank. The count is published as minItems/maxItems 4.

stage.description: One resolved stage. Only the lenses stage carries a lens source and lens rows; only the synthesize stage carries a model hint.

kind.description: The stage this is: lenses, synthesize, dedupe, or rank.

lens_source.description: Where the lenses stage's rows came from: the entry listed them (declared), or it listed none and the bundle's loaded lenses stand in, in file order (bundle).

lenses.description: The lens rows the lenses stage names, with the hint and caps the recipe declared for each.

model.description: The synthesizer model hint, when the entry declared one.

stageRender.description: The one pipeline stage a run --print --stage <n> render covers: its 1-based position in $defs/plan.stages, so the rendered stage's own declarations are that row, and the stage kind at that position. run renders the stage's command and launches nothing, so a stage render writes no launcher.json.

index.description: The 1-based position the --stage operand named, over the plan's four stages.

kind.description: The kind at that position: lenses, synthesize, dedupe, or rank.

lensUse.description: One lens the lenses stage names: the id it selects, plus the hint and caps the entry declared for it.

id.description: The lens id the stage names.

model.description: The model hint the entry declared for this lens, when it declared one.

max_files.description: The declared dispatch scope cap, when the entry declared one.

max_findings.description: The declared dispatch return cap, when the entry declared one.
